issue.title: "teamdctl <portchannel> port remove <member>", which is the way to move a port out of the lag in arp test, doesn't work anymore

failure.body:
**Description**
"teamdctl <portchannel> port remove <member>", which is the way to move a port out of the lag in arp test, doesn't work anymore.
There is the following logic in ARP:

    1. Choose 2 ports for test.
    2. If the port belongs to a port channel, remove it out of the port channel via using ` teamdctl PortChannel0002 port remove Ethernet4`.

However, with the latest master, to use the command `teamdctl <portchannel> port remove <member>` is no longer able to achieve that.
I can't say for sure whether the behavior on DUT is expected, but I think to remove a member out of the port channel by using teamdctl command is not a good way as we already have had `config interface portchannel member del <portchannel> <member>` which is a formal command of doing that.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. run arp test on t1-lag topo.
2.
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
After `teamdctl <portchannel> port remove <member>` the port still belongs to the port channel.

**Describe the results you expected:**
The ports are expected to be removed from the port channels
